titles.romaji: The Idolm@ster SideM Wake Atte Mini!
titles.native: アイドルマスター SideM　理由あってMini!

description:
From "THE iDOLM@STER: SideM" franchise which spawned a game, live shows, and comics, comes a short anime featuring the idols from 315 Production in mini form. The total number of idols on the show... is all 46 of them!

(Source: Crunchyroll)
